jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. We are the AI Experience Framework (AIUX) team that builds the platform that powers ServiceNow's AI-first user interfaces. Using modern Lit-based web components, AIUX builds modular, reusable conversational experiences that serve as the technical foundation for conversation-first applications like Employee Slate. This role owns full-stack architectural decisions in a modern JavaScript/component-driven environment, working across AI integration, performance scale, and multi-team coordination — spanning our SSR runtime (server-rendered Lit components, versioned request routing, isolated execution pools) and the ServiceNow Glide platform layer it integrates with. What you'll do: Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and drive the full development lifecycle Build software that is simple to use, allowing customers to extend and customize functionality to meet their specific needs Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while enhancing the existing product suite Apply advanced knowledge of data structures, algorithms, OO design, design patterns, and performance/scale considerations Raise the engineering bar through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and technical direction To be successful in this role you have: Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. Completed a Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar field 3 years of professional software engineering experience with deep expertise in JavaScript and substantial experience in Java or a similar OO language (C++, C#, Go) Passion for JavaScript and the Web as a platform, reusability, and componentization Strong and demonstrated experience with modern UI frameworks: Angular, React, Vue, or Lit Strong and demonstrated knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance/scale considerations Strong and demonstrated knowledge and experience with relational databases: development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization Strong and demonstrated experience in server-side rendering and hydration, including the failure modes specific to isomorphic rendering (markup mismatches, browser-API leakage into server code) Strong and demonstrated systems-level Node.js experience: process/worker isolation (V8 isolates or equivalent sandboxing), HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 semantics, reverse proxying, and designing for concurrent versioned rollouts Comfortable working across a JVM/Maven backend (Java, ServiceNow Glide platform conventions) in addition to a Node/TypeScript SSR stack Demonstrated experience as a senior individual contributor responsible for code quality, and mentoring Exposure to multiple technology stacks: Cloud Dev, Platforms, Web Dev, Frameworks, service-oriented architecture Preferred — AIUX Framework specific Experience with build systems that emit multiple targets from one component source (server bundles vs. code-split browser bundles) Hands-on experience operating services in Kubernetes: deployment configuration, scaling, rollout/rollback, and incident response Experience building and maintaining observability tooling (Grafana dashboards, Prometheus alerting) for production systems For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $130,000 - jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, 3PX Analytics & Insights
jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic and rapidly growing business within Amazon and the leader in providing secure, reliable, scalable, and innovative services that help over a million businesses, governments, education, and not for profits across the globe scale and grow! AWS provides a wide set of scalable services to meet customer needs. At AWS, the Global Deal Strategy and Programs (GDSP) team drives cloud adoption and business growth through innovative pricing strategies. The organization comprises two specialized teams: Strategic Customer Engagements, which guide transformative deals with industry leaders, and Private Pricing Programs & Experiences, which scales and optimizes pricing solutions across our diverse customer base. Within GDSP, you will develop deep expertise in cloud economics, hone your strategic thinking, and directly impact AWS's market leadership while working with latest technologies and global clients. Key job responsibilities We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to join the Analytics & Insights team within AWS Global Deal Strategy & Programs (GDSP). In this role, you'll design and build scalable, AI-integrated analytics platforms and seller-facing tools that power data-driven decision making across AWS's global sales organization. You'll work across the full stack, from data pipelines and APIs to interactive dashboards and conversational AI agents, delivering solutions that serve thousands of AWS sellers, managers, and leaders. The ideal candidate is passionate about building at the intersection of data engineering and Generative AI, thrives in a fast-paced environment with high ownership expectations, and can translate complex business requirements into reliable, production-grade software. You'll partner closely with product, business , and sales teams to deliver tools that directly impact AWS's commercial motions. Architect, design, and build scalable, integrated solutions for sales analytics and tooling used by teams with AWS globally Develop AI-powered tools and conversational agents leveraging Generative AI, large language models, and Amazon Bedrock to automate seller workflows, surface data insights, and reduce manual operational overhead Build and integrate MCP (Model Context Protocol) services that connect sales data to agentic AI experiences, enabling sellers to query data, generate reports, and take action through natural-language interaction Design and implement intelligent automation using agentic frameworks to replace legacy, manual processes with self-service, AI-enabled tooling Partner cross-functionally with technology teams, business intelligence, finance, and field operations to develop solutions integrated into end-to-end seller experiences About the team The GDSP 3PX Analytics & Insights (A&I) team is the centralized data engineering and analytics partner for AWS's Private Pricing organization. We own the end-to-end data platform from core data modeling and pipeline infrastructure to reporting artifacts and self-serve analytics providing data-driven support to Private pricing stake owners across AWS. We are a high-ownership, fast-moving team consisting of PMT’s, Business intelligence Engineers, Data Engineers and Software development Engineers who thrive in ambiguity and deliver at pace. We manage a broad portfolio spanning multiple business verticals while maintaining a strong bar for data quality, operational rigor, and customer obsession. Our data ecosystem and insights are foundational to how Private Pricing programs are designed, measured, and evolved directly shaping the strategies that drive AWS's largest and most complex enterprise deals worldwide. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent - Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: ASIC Design Engineer - New College Grad 2026
jobs.description: Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA is looking for an ASIC Design Engineer - New College Grad 2026 to join our Memory Subsystem Team! What you'll be doing : As a member of our Memory Subsystem Design team, you will collaborate with architects/design verification/formal verification/physical design team to deliver a world-class solution. NVIDIA SOC Interconnects, ordering controllers and memory accelerators are among the industry's most sophisticated because of the complex area, latency, power, bandwidth and quality-of-service requirements. In this position, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the micro-architecture and design including RTL design, synthesis and timing analysis using innovative CAD tools and using the latest process technologies. What we need to see: Currently pursuing or recently completed a BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineer or related degree (or equivalent experience). Exposure to high-speed coherent interconnects, protocol bridges, hardware-managed coherency and system level caches is a plus Experience with multiple clock domains and asynchronous interfaces is a plus Knowledge of industry specifications like CHI/CXL/PCI-E is a plus. Strong proficiency of Verilog or VHDL. Scripting language like PERL NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 100,000 USD - 166,750 USD for Level 1, and 116,000 USD - 189,750 USD for Level 2. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 14, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. jobs.description: Join us in Bellevue as we innovate on behalf of our customers in Amazon's fastest growing market: emerging markets. We are a team operating at the frontier of Amazon's expansion into emerging markets — regions defined by rich demographic diversity, unique customer behaviors, and infrastructure realities that demand creative, ground-up thinking. Our mission is to build transformative programs that don't just adapt existing solutions but reimagine them entirely for the customers and communities we serve. Through Local Shipping Innovation, we pioneer smarter, faster, and more reliable ways to get packages into the hands of customers. We also lead the charge on Demand Shaping — engineering compelling features and experiences that naturally guide customers toward faster, consolidated delivery options. The result? A win-win: a meaningfully better customer experience and a more operationally efficient Amazon. Innovation is not a buzzword here — it's how we operate every day. Our team is built around a culture of bold experimentation, rapid iteration, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We leverage ML-powered automation at scale to automate complex decisions from inventory forecasting to logistics routing and reducing manual effort and improving accuracy across the board. Alongside this, we build AI-driven personalization experiences that anticipate individual customer needs, delivering tailored solutions that align with both customer expectations and Amazon's business goals. You'll work with a broad range of modern technologies including distributed systems, real-time data pipelines, cloud-native infrastructure, and mobile-first architectures, giving you exposure across the full engineering spectrum. We move quickly, with ideas going from whiteboard to production in weeks, not months. You'll test hypotheses with real customers, learn fast, and iterate faster. jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description: Company: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering General Summary: ** This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship. ** Qualcomm is a world-leading provider of mobile, computing, XR, automotive, and IoT SoCs and software technologies. Our Snapdragon platforms deliver highly integrated CPU/DSP/NPU capabilities that enable premium on-device experiences with industry-leading power efficiency. As a member of Qualcomm’s Windows Audio Software team, you will design and build next-generation on-device Voice AI capabilities on Windows-on-Snapdragon platforms—spanning low-power “always-on” sensing through interactive speech experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, DSP, systems, ML, and product) and work with global stakeholders across regions and sites to deliver robust, production-ready solutions. Responsibilities Own feature development end-to-end for Voice AI capabilities on Windows, including wake-on-voice , on-device ASR , translation , transcription , and TTS . Gather and refine technical requirements with internal and external partners; translate product goals into clear engineering requirements, architecture, and milestones. Co-design and implement Windows audio + driver stack solutions that leverage Qualcomm SoC CPU/DSP/NPU capabilities while meeting strict latency and power targets for Voice AI experiences. Build or extend components across user-mode and kernel-mode boundaries ( UMDF/KMDF ), integrating with Windows audio frameworks and platform services as needed for Voice AI pipelines. Drive low-power audio architecture for “always-on” use cases, including concurrency and power-mode transitions across multiple audio features. Optimize and validate performance using Windows diagnostics and systematically debug complex multi-threaded and multi-processor issues across HW/SW boundaries. Communicate development status, risks, and mitigations to technical leads and stakeholders. Participate in roadmap planning and execution; contribute to process improvements that increase quality, scalability, and maintainability. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field. Preferred Qualifications: Master's Degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field. 2+ years of industry experience in software engineering, with a focus in one or more of the following areas: Windows system software , device drivers, multimedia/audio, platform software, or performance/power-sensitive products. Proficiency in systems programming (C/C++ preferred) and ability to deliver production-quality code in complex codebases. Strong Windows development skills using Visual Studio , source control (Git-based workflows), and disciplined debugging practices. Solid understanding of Windows OS fundamentals relevant to system-level development: processes/threads, synchronization primitives, memory, I/O, and performance diagnostics. Experience developing or integrating Windows drivers using KMDF and/or UMDF , including build, deployment, and debugging fundamentals. Hands-on experience with multi-threaded programming, concurrency control, and performance/latency tuning. Proven ability to work cross-functionally and communicate effectively with distributed teams across regions/time zones. Windows audio ecosystem experience (any of the following): audio drivers, audio endpoints, WASAPI, audio effects/APOs, audio policy, power-aware audio scenarios, or end-to-end audio pipeline integration. Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity across the software lifecycle (requirements/architecture, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation), with the ability to iterate on prompts and validate outputs against real code and requirements. Familiarity with mainstream AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot / Microsoft Copilot ) applied to practical engineering tasks such as code comprehension, change drafting, test scaffolding ideas, and documentation—while maintaining strong review and correctness discipline. Ability to create and share repeatable prompt patterns/templates for common engineering workflows and continuously refine prompts to increase specificity and accuracy. Experience with low-power / always-on audio and power-state transitions (e.g., Modern Standby constraints and wake/trigger flows). Familiarity with on-device voice activation building blocks and staged verification concepts (e.g., multi-stage keyword/wake approaches). Experience optimizing workloads across heterogeneous compute ( CPU + DSP + NPU ) and understanding tradeoffs across latency vs. power vs. quality . Exposure to Voice AI pipelines: ASR/TTS, speech translation, transcription, streaming/buffering strategies, and real-time constraints. Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS
jobs.description: AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Are you passionate about building innovative service architectures that solve real world problems in the context of one of the largest networks on Earth? Do you want to be part of a group that is reducing the complexity of operating the global AWS network backbone for our customers? The AWS network is one of the largest networks in the world, and its performance and availability are key differentiators in delivering the best cloud computing platform available. The AWS Network Backbone Organization owns containerized solutions that protect the AWS network against impact every single day. The team is looking for a Software Development Engineer (SDE) to help expand solutions that support the backbone of the entire AWS global network. In this role, you will work in a hybrid team of software, systems development, and network engineers to understand requirements and extend platforms that support software-defined networks (SDN). You are joining a high performing team interacting closely with other engineering teams across USA, Ireland and Australia. Millions of customers rely on Amazon’s network for using our retail websites, accessing content on their Kindles, and building applications and businesses on top of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud. Our goal is to become The Infrastructure Platform for the world – achieving this goal requires automated and massively scalable software services. Success depends on our world-class network infrastructure, and our network depends on our automation. This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice. Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior engineers truly enjoy mentoring more junior engineers and engineers from non-traditional backgrounds through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth. We try to assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. Key job responsibilities You will be responsible for the design, implementation and quality of services you deliver. Your experience working in software development or in an enterprise environment will help us implement automated solutions across a variety of applications and systems.
